headline: XTGlobal completes payment of interim dividend for FY 2026-27
summary: XTGlobal has successfully paid an interim dividend of 5 paise per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The payout was distributed to eligible shareholders whose names appeared on the register as of the record date of September 23, 2026. The funds were remitted electronically to the shareholders. Indian retail investors holding the stock will see this nominal amount credited to their accounts.
why_it_matters: Nominal dividend payout credited to your account

headline: XTGlobal submits video recording of its 38th AGM
summary: XTGlobal has submitted the video recording of the proceedings of its 38th Annual General Meeting to the stock exchange. This is a standard regulatory compliance filing required of listed companies after holding their AGM. Retail investors can access this recording to review shareholder discussions and management commentary from the meeting. The filing has no direct impact on the company's financial performance or stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate financial impact.

headline: Xtglobal Infotech announces voting results and scrutinizer report for its 38th AGM
hook: Routine AGM approvals concluded at Xtglobal
summary: Xtglobal Infotech Limited has submitted the voting results and scrutinizer's report for its 38th Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2025. The filing is a routine corporate governance formality required for listed entities after shareholders vote on resolutions. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note this is standard compliance procedural news rather than an operational trigger.
why_it_matters: No direct impact on share price or company fundamentals.
